# Identifiers gates/symbol.mjs must not treat as SDK API surface.

# Seeded 2026-08-21 by running the gate over every fence on main. Everything
# below appeared in a documented code sample but not in the owning SDK's source.
# Most are framework or local variables, which are legitimate in a sample.
#
# Add an entry only when the identifier genuinely is not SDK API. If it IS meant
# to be SDK API and is missing from the source, that is a docs bug or an SDK
# bug -- fix it instead of silencing it.

# ---- Framework and application variables (Flask / FastAPI / Rails / Nuxt / Next) ----
email_bp                # Flask blueprint name
welcome_bp              # Flask blueprint name
router                  # FastAPI APIRouter instance
model_config            # Pydantic v2 settings key
runtimeConfig           # Nuxt useRuntimeConfig() result
routes                  # Rails config/routes.rb
assigns                 # Rails ActionMailer assigns
layout                  # Rails mailer layout option
template                # Rails / generic template variable
credentials             # Rails encrypted credentials
plan                    # sample application field (PHP example)

# ---- Local variables in samples ----
body                    # local request/response body variable
html_body               # local variable in a Python sample
login_url               # local variable in a Python sample
loginUrl                # local variable in a PHP sample
supportEmail            # local variable in a Node sample
sendlayerApiKey         # local env-var alias in a Node sample
message_id              # local variable in a PHP sample (API field is MessageID)

# ---- Webhook event-name string constants (REST payload values, not SDK API) ----
bounced_events
message_events
opened_events

# ---- KNOWN REAL BUGS, suppressed only so the gate can ship green ----
# These are NOT false positives. Each is a docs/SDK mismatch that predates the
# pipeline. Remove the entry once fixed so the gate starts enforcing it.
#
# startFrom (node): documented at sdks/nodejs/introduction.mdx:301 and used in a
#   JavaScript fence at guides/get-events.mdx:353, but `GetEventsOptions` in
#   sendlayer-node/src/types.ts:62 has no `startFrom` field and
#   src/events/events.ts never forwards one. Node users following the docs get
#   no pagination. The REST API and the Go/Python/Ruby/PHP SDKs all support it.
